response.sql: WITH counts AS (SELECT observstation, COUNT(*) AS telescope_count FROM telescopes GROUP BY observstation), shares AS (SELECT observstation, telescope_count, 1.0 * telescope_count / SUM(telescope_count) OVER () AS share FROM counts) SELECT observstation, telescope_count, share, share - AVG(share) OVER () AS share_difference FROM shares ORDER BY share_difference DESC LIMIT 10
